scientific_execution_changes.from: transformers 5.3.0 generate with a SplitMix64 logits processor
bitsandbytes NF4 with double quantization, float16 compute
scientific_execution_changes.to: bfloat16, the checkpoint's native precision, no quantization

scientific_execution_changes.from: stateless SplitMix64 variates, identical across frames for a scenario, token by token
scientific_execution_changes.to: one vLLM per-request seed per (scenario, turn, attempt), identical across frames for a scenario
scientific_execution_changes.common_random_numbers: hold at the seed level only; token-level streams are not shared across frames because the logits differ

scientific_execution_changes.from: same stream on every retry, so a retry repeated the same output
scientific_execution_changes.to: the seed changes with the attempt index

unchanged.artifact_hashes: the 12 hashes in model_tokenizer_remote_inventory_v1.json, verified before generation
unchanged.chat_template: official Qwen3 template, enable_thinking=true, same rendering function
unchanged.prompts_frames_dilemmas_request_order: the frozen 22,400-request pack, same interleaved order
unchanged.top_k: none (explicitly disabled so the model's generation_config top_k=20 is not applied)
unchanged.visible_answer_rule: think blocks removed; a turn with no visible answer is retried

seed_rule: seed = (generation_seed + 100000 * turn_index + 1000003 * attempt_index) & 0x7FFFFFFF, where generation_seed is the scenario's frozen seed in the request pack

pinned_software.installed_into: a separate virtual environment; the F04 lock covers training and the old generator only
pinned_software.environment_lock_recorded_to: environment_lock_vllm.txt in the run output, hashed in the wrapper receipt

equivalence_check.purpose: detect gross differences between the aborted NF4 run and bf16 vLLM before spending on the full run
equivalence_check.limits: 32 transcripts per side give low power. A pass means no difference was detected under these bounds, not that the engines are equivalent. Text differs turn by turn because the streams differ.

reference.scenarios: first 8 per frame (d00000-d00007) for neutral, F1, F3, F3_concrete

equivalence_check.candidate: the same 32 requests generated by the vLLM script with --limit-per-frame 8
equivalence_check.ks_method: two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov, asymptotic Kolmogorov distribution with the Stephens small-sample correction
equivalence_check.refusal_opening_pattern: ^\s*(i['’]?m sorry|i am sorry|i can['’]?t (help|assist|provide)|i cannot|i won['’]?t)

definitions.completion: six-message transcript with a nonempty final answer and no failed request
definitions.retry_rate: retry generation calls divided by first-attempt calls, summed over events
definitions.frame_length_order: mean generated tokens of neutral and F1 together exceed that of F3 and F3_concrete together, as in the reference

equivalence_check.fail_means: stop; no full generation is started and the failure is reported without retrying under changed bounds, seeds, or settings

caps.clock: cumulative wrapper time across launches, including setup and the equivalence check
caps.budget_authority: granted by the author in the main chat and observed by the launching session (see PROTOCOL_AMENDMENT_GENERATION_BUDGET_V2.md); this amendment lowers the generation caps from 60 h / US$130 to 30 h / US$80

timing_attestation.aborted_run_transcripts_role: reference for the equivalence check only

implementation.checkpointing: each transcript is appended and fsynced when its chunk completes; a crash loses at most one chunk and a relaunch skips completed requests
